what_happened: The retry of the design job "design note on many agents, few concurrent builds" was rejected at the final verdict. One of 8 acceptance criteria was unmet: the measurements section, which must split job wall time over the last 3 days into model time, local build and test time, and waiting. The verifier raised one major finding. The paragraph "What the jobs left out of the sample are" (section 3 of docs/design/many-agents-few-builds.md) names the wrong population. It does not describe the roughly 80 directories that hold only a request. That was the earlier job's finding (c), and the retry left it unfixed. The event lists no failed checks.
cause: Design jobs have no required step that inventories the real recorded data before the note describes it. Here the data was the job directories, including those that hold only a request. A retry also has no checklist that carries each finding from the earlier verdict into the new attempt. The reading, the plan and the producer treat the sample description as prose, and nothing compares it with a count taken from the state directory. Only the verifier checks it, at the end, so the same defect survived a second attempt.
prevention: Add two things to design and measurement jobs. First, a required inventory step: before writing any sample or population claim, the producer queries the job records and state directory, then records counts by category (complete jobs, request-only directories, others). The doc's "left out" line must match those counts, and a code check should refuse a line whose categories or counts are missing. Second, for retries, the reading must list each prior verifier finding as its own acceptance item, so a finding left unfixed is a visible unmet item before the final verdict.
proposed_request: Fix docs/design/many-agents-few-builds.md section 3 only. Count the job directories in the Athena state directory over the last 3 days by category: jobs with full records, and directories that hold only a request (about 80). Rewrite the paragraph "What the jobs left out of the sample are" so it names that population with the counted numbers and the command or file each count came from. Keep the rest of the note unchanged. Acceptance: the paragraph states the request-only directories and their count, each number cites its source, and no other section of the note changes.
